title: EasyVolcap: Accelerating Neural Volumetric Video Research
abstract: Time Depth Time Camera 0 Camera 1 Camera 0 Figure 1: EasyVolcap is a Python & PyTorch library for accelerating volumetric video research, particularly in the area of neural dynamic scene representation, reconstruction, and rendering.Given multi-view video input, EasyVolcap streamlines the process of data preprocessing, 4D reconstruction, and rendering of dynamic scenes.
